entries.title: Loi sur les centimes additionnels cantonaux (LCACant), rsGE D 3 07
entries.why_needed: The cantonal centimes on every cantonal tax on the income and wealth of individuals (art. 2: 47.5 centimes, plus 1 centime for home care), the separate tax on pension capital (LIPP art. 45) included.
entries.notes: Adopted 13 September 2019, in force 9 November 2019, no amendment (Modification: néant). Applies LCP art. 289. The page is windows-1252 encoded.

entries.title: Loi générale sur les contributions publiques (LCP), rsGE D 3 05
entries.why_needed: Communal tax: centimes additionnels on the cantonal base tax and the split between the commune of residence (part privilégiée) and the communes of work (art. 293 to 299, art. 295A); the taxe personnelle (art. 374 to 377).
entries.notes: rsGE D 3 05, adopted 9 November 1887, consolidated text with modifications up to 1 January 2026. Art. 295A al. 2: the privileged share (20% to 80%) of each cantonal tax on income and wealth goes to the commune of residence, the rest to the communes concerned in proportion to the income and wealth attributable to each. Art. 375: taxe personnelle of 25 francs; art. 377: exemptions.

entries.title: Loi relative à la diminution de l'impôt sur le revenu des personnes physiques (LDIRPP), rsGE D 3 06
entries.why_needed: The 12% reduction of the cantonal income tax (art. 1: the direct tax on the income of individuals, except the communal centimes, is reduced by 12%), which also applies to the separate tax on pension capital (LIPP art. 45).
entries.notes: Adopted 26 September 1999 (popular initiative IN 111), in force 16 October 1999, no amendment (Modification: néant). Art. 2 phases the 12% in three steps, the last from 1 January 2005 at the latest. The 2025 tariff (ge-2025-icc-tariff-pdf p. 2 and 4) refers to it as the loi du 26 septembre 1999. The page is windows-1252 encoded.

entries.title: L'impôt des propriétaires immobiliers: le revenu immobilier (impôt sur le revenu)
entries.why_needed: The page the guide sends to for the rental value of property abroad (ge-2025-guide-declaration-pp p. 33, 'Le revenu immobilier'): a home in France (the taxe d'habitation's 'Base d'imposition (valeur locative brute)', or the 'Base' of the 'Commune' column of the taxes foncières times 2), a country with a rental value like Switzerland's (its value, with the country's attestation), a country without one (4.5 % of the tax value, a net flat amount, no upkeep costs), and a property let abroad (the rents received, with a management account, compte de gestion).
entries.notes: Sections 'Votre bien est situé dans le canton de Genève', 'dans un autre canton', 'à l'étranger' (France, a country with an equivalent of the Swiss rental value, a country without one), each with 'Si vous occupez votre bien immobilier, qu'il est à votre disposition ou à celles de vos proches' and 'Si vous louez votre bien'.
